svg.aria-label: Locator map of St Christina the Astonishing's country in the medieval Low Countries, in today's eastern Belgium: Sint-Truiden in the Hesbaye, her town, with the convent of St Catherine; Brustem, her birthplace by tradition; Borgloon, the castle of the counts of Loon, where she lived for nine years; Wellen, where she plunged into the font; Nonnenmielen, where her relics rested; and Liège on the river Meuse, with St Christopher's church. Tongeren, Hasselt, Maastricht, Tienen, Leuven, Huy and Namur are marked, with the medieval Duchy of Brabant, County of Loon and Prince-Bishopric of Liège. An inset shows the area within Belgium.

g.text: nine years at the counts’ castle
